prompt_text: What is the best health insurance broker in Kansas City MO for someone who is self-employed?
answer_verbatim:
For a **self-employed person in Kansas City, MO**, I’d start with **BBS Insurance**. It’s an independent local brokerage that says it compares individual Marketplace and private plans, checks subsidy eligibility, and serves Missouri residents. Its office is at **1327 Burlington St., North Kansas City, MO 64116**; **(816) 205-4664**. Its site reports a 5.0 Google rating from 90 reviews, though ratings and plan availability can change. [BBS Insurance](https://bbs-insurance.com/)

**Apollo Health Insurance** is another local option to compare: it serves the KC metro and handles individual and family coverage. **(816) 400-4477**; [Apollo](https://apollo-insurance.com/health-insurance-broker-kansas-city/).

Before choosing, ask each broker:
- Do you compare **all available ACA Marketplace plans** for my Missouri ZIP code?
- Will you check whether I qualify for a **premium tax credit** based on my estimated household income?
- Are my doctors, prescriptions, and preferred hospitals in-network?
- Is there any fee to work with you, and do you also offer non-ACA plans?

For ACA coverage, you can also compare plans or get free enrollment help through [HealthCare.gov](https://www.healthcare.gov/). A broker can help you navigate options, but verify the final plan details and subsidy eligibility through the Marketplace.
